name: Martin Pell
bio: Former assistant manager at a laminating shop. Believes most problems are scheduling problems, and most scheduling problems can be laminated. Your oldest friend. Wants the movement to function.
exit: I’ve laminated my resignation. It’s in the orange pouch. I’d like the pouch back eventually.

name: Priya Moss
bio: Brings soup to things. Has never once been asked to. Thinks the point of all this is for people to have a nice time together, and is the only person who has said so out loud.
exit: I’m taking the big pot. The small pot is yours. Make soup for someone, sometime.

name: Desmond “Dez” Ferrante
bio: Has a megaphone. Nobody knows where he got it. Wants everyone in the world to join, ideally by Friday. Makes promises the way other people breathe.
exit: I’m going to start something. Something small, at first. I’ve already told the radio.
habit: makes promises the rest of us have to keep

name: Gary Bonk
bio: Owns the garage. Thought this was a book club. Still brings the book. Kind, loyal, frequently asleep, and the only person who has never asked what the movement is for.
exit: I’m going to have a lie down. A long one. In the garage. It’s still my garage.
habit: falls asleep in the second row

name: Agnes Thimble
bio: Takes minutes at meetings she was not invited to. Remembers exactly what everyone said, and exactly when they stopped meaning it. Wants the movement to be what it said it was.
exit: I am resigning. The minutes will show that I resigned with dignity. I am writing them now.
habit: minutes the things nobody else was listening to

name: Rolf Ledger
bio: Accountant. Genuinely helpful, genuinely good with numbers, and genuinely unable to look at a tradition without seeing an untapped revenue stream.
exit: I’ve closed my ledger. The figures are in order. You are not.
habit: finds money where nobody thought to look

name: Ophelia Stroud
bio: Started a branch in a town nobody had heard of and tripled it before anyone noticed. Ambitious, warm in public, precise in private. Believes the movement belongs to the people who are growing it, not the people who started it.
exit: The branches know where to find me. So, I suspect, will you.
habit: grows a branch while nobody is watching

name: Lionel Fitch
bio: A management consultant who came to one meeting to observe and stayed to restructure. Speaks fluently in departments. Martin’s natural ally, and therefore his greatest threat.
exit: I’m restructuring myself out of the organisation. It’s the most efficient decision I’ve ever made.

name: Constance Pryor
bio: Runs the national office. Has never met you in person and considers this a strength. Communicates exclusively by memo, each beginning “Further to my last memo”. Wants the movement to still exist in a hundred years, ideally unchanged.
exit: Further to my last memo: this is my last memo.
habit: sends a memo before anything can happen

name: Tobias Wren
bio: Built the Northern Region from four people and a minibus. Runs it like a small, sincere principality. Believes the North does the customs properly and everyone else is doing an impression.
exit: The North will remember this. The North remembers everything. It’s cold up there; there’s not much else to do.
habit: issues edicts nobody asked him to issue

name: Juniper Hale
bio: Nineteen. Grew up in the movement; her parents met at a meeting. Knows every custom, every song and every founding story, and has corrected you about your own life more than once. Thinks of you the way people think of a statue.
exit: I’ll always love what this was. I just think I loved the version in the book.
habit: knows the words to all the songs
flavour: set to a song everyone knows
